program.name: Pull-up Express
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: A short pull-up day: an EMOM one day, two ladders the next.
program.about: Pull-ups for the shorter days. One day is an EMOM of pull-ups, a push, a second pull and hanging core work; the other is two ladders, each a pull-up paired with a push or squat. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
